niche: Edtech / Test Prep (JEE, NEET, UPSC, CAT)
destination: Website traffic to subscription signup (primary); app install + lead-form secondary
ad_intro:
Unacademy (unacademy.com) is one of India's largest test-prep platforms and was acquired by upGrad in a deal that closed September 1, 2026 (~$206M, roughly 94% below its $3.44B 2021 peak). We identified ~90 active Meta creatives running across India (JEE, NEET, UPSC, CAT, GATE, Bank/SSC, plus the Airlearn language app). Estimated spend is Rs.2-4 Cr/mo - a shadow of pre-2022 levels after marketing was cut ~70%, but still a material budget. FY25 revenue was Rs.826 Cr (down 16.4% YoY) against a net loss of Rs.435 Cr.

The funnel leaks at three obvious points: (1) Creative: ads are influencer/educator talking-head heavy with very little topper/result UGC or parent-testimonial variety - the exact gap its listed rival Physics Wallah exploits. (2) Landing page: paid traffic lands on a generic brand homepage ("Crack your goal with India's top educators") with no course-specific page, no topper reviews above the fold, and a phone-OTP-only signup gate that adds friction. (3) Tracking: the site is a Next.js SPA; pixel/CAPI is not verifiable on first paint and, post-merger, Unacademy and upGrad tags will need consolidation to avoid double-counting.

These are fixable in 7 days. Realistic caution: this is an enterprise lead in active integration and cost-cutting mode, so closability is moderate - pitch efficiency and post-merger consolidation, not 'spend more'. WARM lead.

findings: Creative leak: Ads lean on educator/influencer talking-heads and 'Join for free' promos. Very few topper-AIR interviews, parent testimonials, or centre/franchise walkthroughs. Result-UGC is the one format Physics Wallah scales that Unacademy under-uses.

Copy leak: Over-reliance on 'free class' / discount hooks ('Join for free', 'Unlimited access'). Missing angles: topper case study, failure-avoidance ('don't drop another year'), parent ROI, and post-merger trust ('now backed by upGrad').

Landing page leak: Paid traffic lands on the generic unacademy.com hero. No course-specific landing pages, no topper result counts or reviews above the fold, a phone-OTP-only signup gate, and the app-install CTA competes with the subscription CTA.

Tracking leak: Next.js SPA - pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint (plain fetch is also blocked by bot protection). Post-merger, Unacademy and upGrad tags need consolidation to stop double-counting and duplicate retargeting. Retargeting appears one-size-fits-all, not exam-specific.
competitors: Scales topper-AIR result creatives + faculty UGC; ~Rs.5-10 Cr/mo Meta spend; growing revenue (Rs.2,887 Cr FY25).

wins: WIN 1 - Creative: 15 Topper-Result UGC Reels + Post-Merger Trust Angle

Shoot 15 fifteen-second Reels: (a) recent JEE/NEET/UPSC toppers describing how Unacademy helped, (b) 5 parent testimonials, (c) 5 franchise-centre walkthroughs. Add a post-merger trust line ('now backed by upGrad'). Replace 30% of talking-head creatives. Expected: CTR +30-50%, CPA -15-25% within 10 days.
WIN 2 - CRO: Course-Specific Landing Pages + Fix the OTP-Only Gate

Route each exam ad to unacademy.com/goal/<jee> etc. with UTMs instead of the generic homepage. Add topper AIR counts + reviews + 'backed by upGrad' above the fold, a sticky 'Enroll' CTA, and an email signup option alongside OTP to cut drop-off. Expected: CVR +30-40%.
WIN 3 - Tracking: Server-Side CAPI + Post-Merger Tag Consolidation

Fire Meta Pixel + CAPI server-side on /signup, /subscribe and /pay. Consolidate Unacademy and upGrad pixels to stop double-counting after the acquisition. Build 3 retargeting audiences (visited goal page, started checkout, app-opened-not-subscribed) with exam-specific creatives. Expected: recapture 10-15% of dropped signups; cleaner attribution.
